The 7 Best Bingo Games for Baby Showers

Published February 24, 2026 by MyBingoCard Team

Baby shower bingo is the one game that never fails. It keeps guests engaged, requires zero setup stress, and works for groups of every size. But not all baby shower bingo is created equal — some variations are far more fun than others.

After helping thousands of hosts plan their baby showers, we've identified the 7 best baby shower bingo games that guests consistently rave about. Each variation puts a unique twist on the classic format.

1. Gift Bingo (The Classic)

How it works: Before the shower, create bingo cards with common baby gifts in each square — diapers, onesies, pacifiers, baby blankets, etc. As the mom-to-be opens gifts, guests mark off matching items on their cards.

Why guests love it: It transforms gift opening — often the longest part of a shower — into an exciting, competitive game. Instead of passively watching, everyone is actively engaged.

Pro tip: Include both obvious items (diapers, wipes) and specific ones (baby thermometer, white noise machine) to keep the game balanced.

2. Baby Word Bingo

How it works: Cards feature baby-related vocabulary — "nursery," "lullaby," "swaddle," "teething," etc. A caller draws words from a bowl and reads them aloud.

Why guests love it: It's fast-paced, easy to understand, and great for groups where not everyone knows each other. The caller format keeps energy high.

3. Baby Prediction Bingo

How it works: Each square has a prediction about the baby — "born before due date," "over 7 pounds," "has mom's eyes," "first word is dada," etc. Guests mark which ones they think will come true.

Why guests love it: It creates hilarious discussions and debates. Plus, you can revisit the cards months later to see who predicted correctly!

4. Baby Emoji Bingo

How it works: Replace text with baby-themed emojis or cute illustrations. The caller shows an emoji and guests match it on their cards.

Why guests love it: The visual format is engaging and inclusive — perfect when guests speak different languages or when kids are playing too.

5. Diaper Raffle Bingo

How it works: Guests who bring a pack of diapers receive a bingo card. This combines a practical gift with a fun game.

Why guests love it: It incentivizes bringing diapers (which the parents will desperately need) and gives diaper-bringers an exclusive game to play.

6. Name That Tune Baby Bingo

How it works: Cards feature lullabies and baby-themed songs. Play short clips and guests mark the song on their card.

Why guests love it: It's a fun mashup of music trivia and bingo. Works especially well with a speaker system.

7. Custom Story Bingo

How it works: Cards feature things the parents-to-be might say or do during the shower — "says 'so cute!'", "tears up," "takes a photo," "hugs someone." Guests observe and mark throughout the event.

Why guests love it: It turns the whole shower into a game. Guests pay closer attention to everything happening, creating a more connected experience.

Tips for Running Baby Shower Bingo

  • Print extras — Always print 20% more cards than you think you need
  • Provide markers — Small stickers, stamps, or M&Ms work great as bingo markers
  • Announce prizes upfront — Guests play harder when they know what they're competing for
  • Play multiple rounds — First to a line, then full card, with different prizes
